spot_checks.title: 图谱规模
spot_checks.cypher: MATCH (n) RETURN count(n) AS 节点数

spot_checks.title: 关系规模
spot_checks.cypher: MATCH ()-[r]->() RETURN count(r) AS 关系数

spot_checks.title: 标签分布
spot_checks.cypher: MATCH (n) RETURN n.id AS 名称 LIMIT 5

spot_checks.title: 疾病-症状抽样
spot_checks.cypher: MATCH (d:Disease)-[r:HAS_SYMPTOM]->(s:Symptom) RETURN d.name AS 疾病, s.name AS 症状, r.qa_id AS 来源 LIMIT 5

spot_checks.title: 疾病-检查抽样
spot_checks.cypher: MATCH (d:Disease)-[r:REQUIRES_EXAM]->(e:Examination) RETURN d.name AS 疾病, e.name AS 检查, r.scope AS 性质 LIMIT 5

spot_checks.title: 癫痫相关
spot_checks.cypher: MATCH (d:Disease {name: '癫痫'})-[r]->(x) RETURN x.name AS 关联实体, r.qa_id AS 来源 LIMIT 10
